purpose: Record the final unrestricted pre-release audit and the deliberate inclusion of the official UFC scientific-article profile, without implementing new normative predicates, runtime behavior, proof-state changes, release-version changes or repository cleanup inside N15-A.

findings.title: Official UFC scientific-article guide is missing from the active source inventory
findings.observation: The current UFC normalization page lists five guides, while normativa/source-audit.json and tests/checks/normative_sources.py model four institutional guides. The omitted fifth source is the UFC Guide for Elaboration of Articles in Scientific Periodicals.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B1 must add the fifth UFC guide to the audited institutional source inventory, classify it as an institutional guide without authority to select obsolete technical editions, add the current applicable ABNT article-presentation standard, and reconcile stale embedded technical references before any article rule is promoted into the runtime contract.

findings.title: Related UFC graduate-program acts need explicit authority classification
findings.observation: The current UFC thesis/dissertation receiving page lists MEC Portaria 1.224/2013, CEPE Resolution 17/2015 and CAPES Portaria 59/2017. Review of CEPE Resolution 17/2015 shows that graduate-program collegiate bodies may define presentation directives for dissertations and theses, so this source cannot be dismissed as merely operational. The MEC and CAPES acts must still be classified separately according to their actual scope.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B1 must register CEPE Resolution 17/2015 as an applicable institutional source for program-level presentation exceptions and reconcile it with the general ABNT/UFC regime of CEPE Resolution 17/2017. MEC Portaria 1.224/2013 and CAPES Portaria 59/2017 must be explicitly classified as applicable or contextual without acquiring technical authority by implication.

findings.title: Source-audit scope still names v2.1.0
findings.observation: normativa/source-audit.json and tests/checks/normative_sources.py still require the scope identifier abntexto-ufc-v2.1.0-current-sources.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B1 must move the scope identifier to a release-independent current-source form while preserving explicit source authority and review dates.

findings.title: Human normative map still describes the v2.1.0 release state
findings.observation: docs/NORMAS.md still states that V2.1.0 was audited for release and refers to the prior Gate F state.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B/C must update audit/release-state wording while preserving normative values and locators.

findings.title: Reference PDF bit reproducibility remains unresolved
findings.observation: GitHub issue #18 remains open. The historical v2.1.0 main/tag reference PDFs differed only in generated PDF metadata/ID, while current deterministic bundle checks do not independently prove that two production reference builds are byte-identical.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B3/C must build the production reference path twice under a controlled SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and compare exact SHA-256 hashes, fixing metadata generation if required.

findings.title: Release surfaces intentionally remain at 2.1.0
findings.observation: Makefile, abntexto-ufc.cls and CTAN-facing documentation still identify the published 2.1.0 release. This is correct before final promotion but must be synchronized atomically for the v2.2.0 release candidate.
findings.required_disposition: N15-C must promote all version-bearing release surfaces together and rerun release metadata/package gates.

findings.title: Reference-validation workflow appears tied to an older branch strategy
findings.observation: .github/workflows/reference-validation.yml watches validation/v2.* pushes and release/v2.* pull requests. No validation/v2.* branch currently exists, while the current release path uses main, exact Gate T and Distribution.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B3 or final cleanup must prove whether this workflow still has a unique supported use before retaining or removing it.

findings.title: Remote branch inventory is heavily accumulated
findings.observation: The audit observed 131 remote branches, dominated by completed audit/docs/fix campaigns.
findings.required_disposition: After final v2.2.0 certification/tag, delete branches whose evidence is represented by PR and Actions history. Preserve main, 1.x and any branch with unreconciled unique content until reviewed.

findings.title: Historical release rehearsal branch must not be merged
findings.observation: release/v2.2.0-certification belongs to closed unmerged PR #36 and represents historical D5 rehearsal evidence rather than the final release source tree.
findings.required_disposition: Derive N15-C fresh from certified main and retain the rehearsal branch only until its useful evidence has been reconciled.

findings.title: Historical N13 release branches are stale cleanup candidates
findings.observation: release/v2.2.0-corpus-check and release/v2.2.0-n13-typography-check contain old N13 campaign state while N13 is already closed and re-certified on main.
findings.required_disposition: Retain through final certification and remove in the physical cleanup pass if no unique evidence remains.

findings.title: tmp-noop branch has no unique content
findings.observation: tmp-noop is behind main, ahead_by=0 and has no changed files against its merge base.

findings.title: Planning branch has substantial unique divergent history
findings.observation: planning/v2.2.0-normative-verification has substantial unique historical plans/audits and old implementation deltas.
findings.required_disposition: Before deletion, decide which unique planning/audit documents are already represented by the canonical handoff, normativa, tests, PRs and Actions. Move only genuinely useful historical documents to docs/history/ and never merge the old code tree wholesale.

findings.title: Official UFC scientific-article profile is not implemented
findings.observation: The official UFC article guide defines a document profile materially different from the existing academic-work and research-project profiles. Among the observed distinctions are article-specific structure, a 150-to-250-word abstract, single line spacing for the article body, page numbering visible from the first page, continuous primary sections rather than forcing each primary section to a new page, and article-specific authorship and submission/approval-date elements. The current runtime/profile matrix has no article profile.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B2 must deliberately add a scientific-article profile, derive a bounded article.* contract from the reconciled current source set, implement the profile without altering existing academic/project defaults, add fixtures/final-PDF evidence/negative sensitivity/profile-matrix coverage, and keep target-journal author instructions as an explicit applicability/override boundary rather than claiming that the UFC baseline supersedes journal rules.

passes.observation: README.md does not claim that the project is already the officially published UFC LaTeX template. The current official UFC templates page still marks the Overleaf/LaTeX model as Em atualização.
Reference photographs have explicit CC BY-SA 4.0 provenance; the UFC institutional mark is retained in source but excluded from public/CTAN bundles; proprietary Microsoft fonts are not redistributed.
Stable branches main and 1.x are protected against deletion/non-fast-forward changes, require linear history and squash PRs, and version tags v* are immutable.
The Windows literal-font proof scripts and Unicode-encoding helper are consumed by the certified N12 route and are not orphaned.
Proof-state remains intentionally conservative: green evidence and closed phases do not auto-promote rules to PROVEN.
Distribution #235 passed the full pre-release distribution path on the N14-closed main tree; final D5 must still be repeated after N15-C changes.

audit_limitations.statement: Licensed ABNT full text is not reproduced or inferred beyond available authoritative locators and existing audited evidence. Unavailable text remains unavailable/partial.

A direct network git clone was unavailable in the audit execution environment. Repository-wide claims are grounded in GitHub API inventory, existing repository audits, executable gates and targeted file inspection.

N15-A records the deliberate inclusion of the article profile but does not itself change the normative contract. New article sources, predicates, locators, proof-state rows and runtime behavior must be introduced explicitly and conservatively in N15-B after current-edition reconciliation.

n15_plan.N15-A: Final unrestricted audit, deliberate article-scope decision and explicit finding ledger.
n15_plan.N15-B1: Reconcile source completeness: fifth UFC guide, current article technical standard, stale embedded references, CEPE 17/2015 program-exception authority, other related acts, source-scope metadata and normative-currentness documentation.
n15_plan.N15-B2: Define, implement and evidence the UFC scientific-article profile with an explicit article.* contract and target-journal override boundary while preserving existing profiles.
n15_plan.N15-B3: Resolve remaining pre-release corrections, including reference-PDF reproducibility, stale release-state documentation and workflow/repository review items that affect release readiness.
n15_plan.N15-C: Create the v2.2.0 release candidate, synchronize version metadata, run controlled double-build reproducibility and build final distribution candidates.
n15_plan.N15-D: Run final exact-head source/validator/preflight/Gate-T/Distribution certification and make the GO/NO-GO release decision.
n15_plan.post_release_cleanup: After certification/tag, perform physical branch/repository cleanup from the audited cleanup inventory.
